name: What should I do immediately after a sink overflows?

mainEntity.name: What should I do immediately after a sink overflows?

acceptedAnswer.text: Immediately after a sink overflow, turn off the water supply to prevent further damage. If the water source is unclear, locate and turn off your main water shut-off valve. Then, begin removing standing water using towels, buckets, or a wet vacuum if available. Open windows and turn on fans to improve air circulation. Avoid using electrical appliances in wet areas. Contact a professional water damage restoration service promptly, especially if the overflow involves contaminated water or has spread beyond the immediate area, as hidden moisture can lead to mold and structural issues.
acceptedAnswer.description: Turn off the water supply immediately and begin removing standing water. Contact a professional restoration service if the damage is significant or involves contaminated water.
